requirements.desc: `sdd-forge flow run finalize-cleanup` must preserve stdout as one JSON envelope and, on ok:true with `data.report.text`, emit that exact text in a human-readable `Finalize Report` block to a non-stdout channel during the same command invocation.
requirements.note: R1: writes one JSON envelope to stdout and the Report block to stderr

requirements.desc: The cleanup Report display block must use the same finalized spec report text that `sdd-forge flow report show` prints immediately after cleanup, with no alternate formatter and no fabricated content.
requirements.note: R2: displays the exact report-show text for the finalized report

requirements.desc: When cleanup teardown succeeds but the Report cannot be read, the command must keep ok:true, set `data.report` to null, include a `REPORT_MISSING` warning, and emit a visible warning that names the missing Report problem instead of a Report block.
requirements.note: R3: REPORT_MISSING emits a visible warning and no fabricated Report block

requirements.desc: For `flow run finalize-cleanup` executed inside a worktree, if the effective `agentWorkDir`, explicit `--log-file`, or `config.logs.dir` resolves inside the worktree path, the CLI must resolve the corresponding logger and runtime log paths under the main repository before creating those logs.
requirements.note: R4: relocates the default runtime log when --agent-work-dir is under the deleted worktree

requirements.desc: A successful finalize-cleanup with `--agent-work-dir`, `--log-file`, or `config.logs.dir` pointing under the deleted worktree must not emit `[sdd-forge] log write failed` or runtime-log ENOENT warnings after the worktree is removed.
requirements.note: R5: cleanup stderr contains no deleted-worktree log write warning

requirements.desc: The finalize-cleanup prompt, generated flow skill template, and generated installed skill copies should describe that cleanup emits the Report itself without reintroducing a legacy post-cleanup report-show instruction.
requirements.note: R6: prompt and skills describe CLI Report display without legacy report-show fallback

requirements.desc: Spec-local tests under `specs/261-finalize-report-delivery/tests/` must cover R1 through R5 with `// spec: R<N>` headers and must include a fixture where `--agent-work-dir` is under a worktree that cleanup deletes.
requirements.note: R7: spec-local tests declare and name every requirement they cover
